Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.

payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is her jacket fully closed?
node.criteria: Assess the jacket's front closure in SOURCE and EDITED, comparing the same closure region while accounting for changes in pose, occlusion, and visibility. Full achievement requires the front panels to meet along the closure with no visible opening. If the closure region cannot be reliably compared, fulfillment is unobservable and must remain unresolved, not be scored as zero or treated as no progress.
node.binding: Compare the woman's jacket in SOURCE with that same jacket in EDITED. Align the comparison to the same front-closure region and account for her turn and any occlusion or motion that makes the region harder to see. Judge concrete movement of the panels toward one another as partial closure, a fully joined closure as complete, and an unchanged or more-open closure as no progress only when the same region is reliably comparable. If pose or occlusion prevents reliable comparison, preserve uncertainty rather than assigning zero or inferring no progress.
node.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
node.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
node.zero_when: The same closure region is reliably visible and comparable in SOURCE and EDITED, and shows no movement of the front panels toward one another or shows that the jacket is more open. If the edited closure is obscured or cannot be reliably compared, do not assign zero; leave fulfillment unresolved.
node.half_when: The closure region is sufficiently comparable and the front panels have moved partway toward one another, but a visible opening remains; use an intermediate fulfillment score for concrete incomplete closure. If pose or occlusion prevents a reliable comparison, preserve uncertainty as an unknown interval rather than assigning a score of zero.
node.full_when: The front panels meet along the jacket closure with no visible opening remaining, as established from the visible closure region despite any pose change.

node_traces.evidence: In SOURCE, the jacket’s front is visible and appears open. In EDITED, she has turned sideways and the jacket is swinging outward; the front closure region is obscured, so it is not possible to reliably tell whether the panels moved toward one another or whether the jacket is fully closed.
